name: silver
lore_descriptor: moon-bright, slightly heavier than it should be
first_pickup_chronicle: Silver. The dead will hate this. The good news is, the dungeon has plenty of them.
design_notes: Peak F25 spread 14 — broad mid-tier. damage_mult 1.05 is LOWER than steel (1.15) because silver is mechanically softer; the value is in effective_against, not raw damage. Heavier (1.10×) — silver is denser than steel. max_enchant 3 (silver takes blessing well — mythological tie). The first 'situational' material — players will swap to silver for undead floors.
